resource: Same-session grace from the authoritative ControlLossEpoch boundary to the original grace deadline
allocation_impact: One original grace deadline per loss epoch, fixed at the loss decision and never restarted or extended; a RECONNECTABLE session keeps its present, uncontrolled actor and its claims until the deadline.
boundary_tests: The committed loss records original_grace_deadline = decision time + 60 s
A replayed identical loss decision keeps the original deadline
notes: Provisional owner value, DISCONNECT-PROTECTION-V1 §4 (#822 comments 5854525644 and 5854565314); matches the Tibia 60 s logout block; to be measured and tuned before release. Expiry release and positive resume are later children.
